_readme: Atomico's cross-investor rulings for COLLECTION.md rule 10 (same schema as data/collection/cross-investor.json; merged by verify at read time). `distinct`: name-key collisions that are different companies. `accepted`: real disagreements whose fix belongs to the wave alignment, because the stale side is another investor's file and §12 forbids editing it from this session. Accepted entries are written as pairs.

distinct.note: different companies: Atomico's Bird is the Amsterdam messaging platform formerly MessageBird (bird.com; Atomico joined its Accel-led 2017 Series A), Sequoia's is Bird Global, the Miami scooter company that went through Chapter 11 in 2023
different companies: Atomico's Hailo is the London taxi-hailing app (Atomico's 2011 seed; merged into mytaxi, now Free Now, in 2016), Felicis's is Hailo Technologies, the Tel Aviv AI-chip company
different companies: Atomico's Quid is the San Francisco text-analytics company (2011 Series C, merged into NetBase Quid in 2020); YC's is a Mexico City company from the Summer 2021 batch

different companies: Atomico's Compass is the New York real-estate brokerage (NYSE: COMP); NEA's is Compass Labs of San Jose, a 2009 real-time search startup
different companies: Atomico's Light is the Copenhagen AI general ledger seeded in 2024; GV's is Light Labs of Palo Alto, the L16 camera maker
different companies: Atomico's Pelago is the New York digital substance-use clinic formerly Quit Genius; Kleiner Perkins's is Pelago, Inc. of Seattle, the Whrrl app bought by Groupon in 2011
different companies: Atomico's Silk is silk.co, the Amsterdam structured-data publisher (2011 seed); Insight's is Silk Security of New York, bought by Armis in 2024
